# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Confirmed the branch already contains the approved shrimp molt/mineral and reproduction-factor fixes from the prior review round, so this apply-fixes pass was validation-only and required no additional source edits. I rechecked the relevant parameter wiring and regression coverage, then reran the focused shrimp suites plus the full `tank_core`, `tank_data`, and `tank_scenarios` test surfaces; all passed on the current branch.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the current worktree and the relevant shrimp molt/mineral parameter and diagnostic paths to confirm the approved fixes were already present before making any edits.
2. [Completed] Reran the focused shrimp regression suites covering mineral-gated molting and reproduction-factor behavior to verify the reviewed paths still pass without further changes.
3. [Completed] Ran the full `tank_core` suite plus downstream `tank_data` and `tank_scenarios` tests to confirm broader stability, then recorded this stage as validation-only because no new fixes were needed.

## Validation Evidence

- `git status --short`
- `rg -n "failed_molt_accum_increase_per_failed_stage|MarginalFailure|test_soft_vs_hard_water_shrimp_survival|molt_failure_diagnostic_thresholds_are_named" crates/tank_core crates/tank_data`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test molt_mineral_budget -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_data`
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios`
- `cargo test -p tank_core -- --nocapture`

## Outstanding Risks

None identified.
